content.rendered:
The week of June 4th – June 8th is Archer Glen Volunteer Week. We appreciate all of the parent, grandparent and community member volunteers that help to make Archer Glen a GREAT school. Without the many hours of volunteer time we would not be able to offer our students opportunities like Art Literature, Oregon Battle Of The Books, Passport and Chess Club along with many other enrichment programs. Our volunteers help with Bulletin Boards, Popcorn Fridays, Friday Folders, Field Trips, reading and math groups and a hundred other school needs. 

As a small thank you to our volunteers we have a Goodie Table in the front office that has treats every day of the week. Volunteers, please grab a treat each day when you are in the building. 
The Archer Glen Volunteers Are Fantastic!
